apps.name: Genshin Daily
apps.subtitle: Daily, weekly & monthly Genshin checklists with sync
apps.localizedDescription:
A sleek checklist dashboard for Genshin Impact dailies, weeklies, monthlies — with live events, current banners, and PC↔phone sync.

Features:
• Three tabs: Today (dailies + daily bosses), Weekly & Monthly, Events & Banners
• Auto-reset at 04:00 server time (Europe / America / Asia)
• Timers for Serenitea Pot plants and Crystal Fly traps
• Live events & banners from ennead.cc API
• Material icons auto-fetched from genshin-db-api
• PC ↔ Phone sync via local network
• Runs on iOS via AltStore/Sideloadly
